request.business_problem: Agents switch between the CRM web app and chat to look up contacts and deals, and sometimes paste client data into the wrong place.
request.tasks: Let Claude look up contacts and deals in our CRM through its REST API, read-only: search contacts by name or email, fetch a deal by id, list open deals for a contact. Only our CRM host may ever be called.
request.existing_tools: Custom CRM with REST API at https://api.crm.tidewater.example/v2 (bearer token), Slack
request.required_output: Compact JSON-like summaries; never the raw token or unrelated fields.

smoke.prompt: Use the CRM tools to find the contact named Ruiz and summarise their open deals.
